decisions.hidden_reasoning:
Let me analyze the opponent's team and choose my 3 Pokémon strategically.

Opponent's team:
- Garchomp (Dragon/Ground) - fast physical attacker
- Dragapult (Dragon/Ghost) - very fast, mixed attacker
- Kingambit (Dark/Steel) - bulky physical attacker, slow
- Gholdengo (Steel/Ghost) - special attacker, immune to status
- Primarina (Water/Fairy) - special attacker, bulky
- Rotom-Wash (Electric/Water) - bulky support, Will-O-Wisp

Key threats:
- Dragapult is the fastest threat (up to 213 Spe), outspeeds everything I have
- Gholdengo is immune to status moves (Good as Gold), hits hard specially
- Kingambit is bulky and hits hard physically
- Garchomp is fast and hits hard

My options:
- Garchomp: Fast physical attacker, can Swords Dance. Weak to Dragon (Dragapult, Hydreigon's opponent), Ice (Primarina's Ice Beam), Fairy (Primarina).
- Hydreigon: Fast special attacker with Levitate (immune to Ground). Can hit Gholdengo with Dark Pulse, hit Primarina with Draco Meteor.
- Kingambit: Bulky, can Swords Dance, suckerpunch priority. Weak to Fighting (Clefable's Focus Blast won't work here), Ground, Fire.
- Rotom-Wash: Bulky, Will-O-Wisp, Volt Switch. Good against Garchomp and Kingambit.
- Corviknight: Very bulky, Roost recovery. Can handle Dragon types well.
- Clefable: Calm Mind + Moonblast. Good against Dragon types (neutral), Fairy hits Garchomp and Kingambit super effectively.

Let me think about matchups:
- Dragapult: Need to handle this. Garchomp is weak to Dragon. Hydreigon can take a hit and hit back with Dark Pulse (neutral). Clefable can Calm Mind up and Moonblast (neutral). Corviknight resists Dragon and can Body Press.
- Gholdengo: Hydreigon's Dark Pulse hits super effectively. Kingambit's Iron Head hits super effectively. Clefable's Focus Blast hits super effectively.
- Kingambit: Garchomp can Swords Dance and Earthquake. Rotom-Wash with Will-O-Wisp. Clefable Moonblast super effective.
- Primarina: Garchomp Earthquake super effective. Hydreigon Draco Meteor. Kingambit Iron Head.
- Garchomp: Rotom-Wash Will-O-Wisp. Hydreigon Levitate immune to Earthquake. Clefable Moonblast.
- Rotom-Wash: Garchomp Earthquake. Hydreigon Earthpower.

I think a good core would be:
- Hydreigon: Great special attacker, Levitate helps against Garchomp and Rotom-Wash's Earthquake. Can hit Gholdengo super effectively with Dark Pulse. Draco Meteor for Primarina.
- Garchomp: Swords Dance sweeper, Earthquake hits many things. But weak to Dragon (Dragapult) and Ice.
- Clefable: Calm Mind sweeper, Moonblast hits Dragon types and Kingambit super effectively. Unaware ignores stat boosts. Focus Blast for Gholdengo.

Actually, let me reconsider. Dragapult is the biggest threat with its speed. I need something that can handle it.

- Hydreigon can take a Dragon Darts (resists Dragon) and hit back with Dark Pulse or Draco Meteor. But it's still in danger.
- Clefable can Calm Mind up and Moonblast (neutral to Dragapult). Unaware ignores Dragapult's potential boosts.
- Corviknight resists Dragon, can Roost and Body Press.

I think Hydreigon + Clefable + Garchomp is a good offensive core. Or maybe Hydreigon + Clefable + Kingambit for more bulk.

Let me go with:
1. Hydreigon (lead) - can handle Gholdengo with Dark Pulse, Levitate helps vs Ground moves, Draco Meteor for Primarina
2. Clefable - Calm Mind sweeper, Moonblast for Kingambit and Garchomp, Focus Blast for Gholdengo, Unaware ignores boosts
3. Garchomp - Swords Dance sweeper, Earthquake for coverage, fast enough to outspeed many things

Actually, leading with Garchomp might be better for immediate pressure. But Hydreigon as lead is safer due to Levitate.

Let me go with Hydreigon lead, Clefable, Garchomp. This gives me:
- Hydreigon: handles Gholdengo (Dark Pulse), Primarina (Draco Meteor), Garchomp (Levitate + Draco Meteor)
- Clefable: handles Kingambit (Moonblast), Garchomp (Moonblast), Gholdengo (Focus Blast), Dragapult (Calm Mind + Moonblast with Unaware)
- Garchomp: handles Primarina (Earthquake), Kingambit (Earthquake/Swords Dance), Rotom-Wash (Earthquake)

This seems like a solid core. Let me go with this.
